 # Specstory CLI Changelog
 
-## v1.11.0 2026-02-24
+## v1.11.0 2026-03-02
 
 ### 📢 Announcements
 
@@ -10,8 +10,13 @@
 
 - `specstory sync` now supports an `--only-stats` flag that skips the full local and/or cloud sync and only generates or updates `./.specstory/statistics.json`.
 
+### ⚙️ Improvements
+
+- Update project directory handling for the Gemini CLI provider. Gemini CLI `v0.30.0+` changed how it names project directories under `~/.gemini/tmp/`. Previously it used a SHA256 hash of the project's absolute path (e.g., `c18385f0...`). Now it uses the project folder's basename and stores the actual project path in a `.project_root` file inside that directory. [Issue #183](https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/issues/183)
+
 ### 🐛 Bug Fixes
 
+- Use file system events rather than polling in Gemini CLI provider to avoid noisy logging activity (every 30s) during `specstory watch`.
 - Ensure Claude Code provider doesn't use session summary self-message as first user message when creating markdown file slug. [Contribution](https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/pull/178) from @salmonumbrella.

+// matchesProjectRoot checks whether dir contains a .project_root file whose
+// content matches canonicalProjectPath (after canonicalization).
+func matchesProjectRoot(dir, canonicalProjectPath string) bool {
+	content, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, ".project_root"))
+	if err != nil {
+		return false
+	}
+
+	storedPath := strings.TrimSpace(string(content))
+	canonicalStored, err := spi.GetCanonicalPath(storedPath)
+	if err != nil {
+		slog.Warn("matchesProjectRoot: Failed to canonicalize stored path, using as-is",
+			"storedPath", storedPath, "error", err)
+		canonicalStored = storedPath
+	}
+
+	return canonicalStored == canonicalProjectPath
+}
+
+// canonicalizeProjectPath returns the canonical form of projectPath for
+// case-insensitive filesystem matching. Falls back to the original path on error.
+func canonicalizeProjectPath(projectPath string) string {
+	canonical, err := spi.GetCanonicalPath(projectPath)
+	if err != nil {
+		slog.Warn("canonicalizeProjectPath: Failed to canonicalize, using as-is",
+			"projectPath", projectPath, "error", err)
+		return projectPath
+	}
+	return canonical
+}
+
+// findProjectDirByBasename tries the most likely name-based directory first:
+// tmpDir/<basename>. Returns the directory path if its .project_root matches,
+// or empty string otherwise.
+func findProjectDirByBasename(tmpDir, projectPath, canonicalProjectPath string) string {
+	basename := filepath.Base(projectPath)
+	candidate := filepath.Join(tmpDir, basename)
+
+	info, err := osStat(candidate)
+	if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
+		return ""
+	}
+
+	if matchesProjectRoot(candidate, canonicalProjectPath) {
+		slog.Info("findProjectDirByBasename: Matched project directory via basename hint",
+			"dir", candidate, "projectPath", projectPath)
+		return candidate
+	}
+
+	return ""
+}
+
+// findProjectDirByProjectRoot scans tmpDir for any subdirectory whose .project_root
+// file content matches projectPath. This supports Gemini CLI v0.30.0+ which uses
+// project-name-based directories (possibly with numeric suffixes like my-project-1).
+func findProjectDirByProjectRoot(tmpDir, projectPath string) (string, error) {
+	canonicalProjectPath := canonicalizeProjectPath(projectPath)
+
+	entries, err := os.ReadDir(tmpDir)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to read Gemini tmp directory %q: %w", tmpDir, err)
+	}
+
+	for _, entry := range entries {
+		if !entry.IsDir() {
+			continue
+		}
+
+		dir := filepath.Join(tmpDir, entry.Name())
+		if matchesProjectRoot(dir, canonicalProjectPath) {
+			slog.Info("findProjectDirByProjectRoot: Found matching project directory via .project_root",
+				"dir", dir, "projectPath", projectPath)
+			return dir, nil
+		}
+	}
 
-	return projectDir, nil

 }

+func TestFindProjectDirByProjectRoot(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name        string
+		projectPath string
+		setup       func(t *testing.T, tmpDir string)
+		wantMatch   bool   // true if we expect a non-empty result
+		wantSuffix  string // expected directory name suffix in the result
+	}{
+		{
+			name:        "match found via .project_root file",
+			projectPath: "/tmp/my-project",
+			setup: func(t *testing.T, tmpDir string) {
+				dir := filepath.Join(tmpDir, "my-project")
+				if err := os.Mkdir(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
+					t.Fatalf("failed to create dir: %v", err)
+				}
+				if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, ".project_root"), []byte("/tmp/my-project\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
+					t.Fatalf("failed to write .project_root: %v", err)
+				}
+			},
+			wantMatch:  true,
+			wantSuffix: "my-project",
+		},
+		{
+			name:        "no match with different project path",
+			projectPath: "/tmp/unrelated-project",
+			setup: func(t *testing.T, tmpDir string) {
+				dir := filepath.Join(tmpDir, "other-project")
+				if err := os.Mkdir(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
+					t.Fatalf("failed to create dir: %v", err)
+				}
+				if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, ".project_root"), []byte("/tmp/other-project\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
+					t.Fatalf("failed to write .project_root: %v", err)
+				}
+			},
+			wantMatch: false,
+		},
+		{
+			name:        "empty tmp directory",
+			projectPath: "/tmp/any-project",
+			setup:       func(t *testing.T, tmpDir string) {},
+			wantMatch:   false,
+		},
+		{
+			name:        "directory without .project_root file skipped",
+			projectPath: "/tmp/any-project",
+			setup: func(t *testing.T, tmpDir string) {
+				dir := filepath.Join(tmpDir, "abcdef1234567890")
+				if err := os.Mkdir(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
+					t.Fatalf("failed to create dir: %v", err)
+				}
+			},
+			wantMatch: false,
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			testTmpDir := t.TempDir()
+			tt.setup(t, testTmpDir)
+
+			got, err := findProjectDirByProjectRoot(testTmpDir, tt.projectPath)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatalf("findProjectDirByProjectRoot returned error: %v", err)
+			}
+
+			if tt.wantMatch {
+				wantDir := filepath.Join(testTmpDir, tt.wantSuffix)
+				if got != wantDir {
+					t.Fatalf("got %q, want %q", got, wantDir)
+				}
+			} else {
+				if got != "" {
+					t.Fatalf("expected empty string, got %q", got)
+				}
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestResolveGeminiProjectDirViaProjectRoot(t *testing.T) {
+	originalGetwd := osGetwd
+	originalUserHome := osUserHomeDir
+	originalStat := osStat
+	t.Cleanup(func() {
+		osGetwd = originalGetwd
+		osUserHomeDir = originalUserHome
+		osStat = originalStat
+	})
+
+	// Use a real temp dir as the project path so canonical path resolution works
+	projectPath := t.TempDir()
+
+	osGetwd = func() (string, error) {
+		return projectPath, nil
+	}
+	fakeHome := t.TempDir()
+	osUserHomeDir = func() (string, error) {
+		return fakeHome, nil
+	}
+
+	tmpDir := filepath.Join(fakeHome, ".gemini", "tmp")
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(tmpDir, 0o755); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("failed to create tmp dir: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	// Create a project-name-based directory with .project_root
+	nameBasedDir := filepath.Join(tmpDir, "my-project")
+	if err := os.Mkdir(nameBasedDir, 0o755); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("failed to create name-based dir: %v", err)
+	}
+	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(nameBasedDir, ".project_root"), []byte(projectPath+"\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("failed to write .project_root: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	// ResolveGeminiProjectDir should find the project via .project_root fallback
+	got, err := ResolveGeminiProjectDir("")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("expected fallback to find project dir, got error: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	if got != nameBasedDir {
+		t.Fatalf("got %q, want %q", got, nameBasedDir)
+	}
+}

+// waitForProjectDir waits for a Gemini project directory using three strategies:
+//  1. Basename hint — tmpDir/<project-basename> with matching .project_root
+//  2. Hash-based — the legacy hash directory
+//  3. Full .project_root scan — handles suffixed dirs like my-project-1
+//
+// If none exist yet, it watches tmpDir for new directory creation.
+func waitForProjectDir(ctx context.Context, tmpDir, projectPath, hashDir string) (string, error) {
+	canonicalProjectPath := canonicalizeProjectPath(projectPath)
+	hashName := filepath.Base(hashDir)
+
+	// checkAll runs all three strategies and returns the first match.
+	checkAll := func() string {
+		// 1. Basename hint
+		if dir := findProjectDirByBasename(tmpDir, projectPath, canonicalProjectPath); dir != "" {
+			return dir
+		}
+		// 2. Hash-based
+		if info, err := os.Stat(hashDir); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
+			slog.Debug("Gemini watcher: hash-based project directory ready", "path", hashDir)
+			return hashDir
+		}
+		// 3. Full scan
+		if match, err := findProjectDirByProjectRoot(tmpDir, projectPath); err == nil && match != "" {
+			return match
+		}
+		return ""
+	}
+
+	// Try existing directories first
+	if dir := checkAll(); dir != "" {
+		return dir, nil
+	}
+
+	// Nothing exists yet — watch tmpDir for new directory creation
+	watcher, err := fsnotify.NewWatcher()
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create fsnotify watcher for project dir: %w", err)
+	}
+	defer func() { _ = watcher.Close() }()
+
+	if err := watcher.Add(tmpDir); err != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to watch tmp directory %q: %w", tmpDir, err)
+	}
+
+	slog.Debug("Gemini watcher: watching for project directory creation",
+		"tmpDir", tmpDir, "hashDir", hashName)
+
+	// Re-check after adding watcher to close the race window
+	if dir := checkAll(); dir != "" {
+		return dir, nil
+	}
+
+	for {
+		select {
+		case <-ctx.Done():
+			return "", ctx.Err()
+		case event, ok := <-watcher.Events:
+			if !ok {
+				return "", fmt.Errorf("fsnotify events channel closed for project dir watcher")
+			}
+			if !event.Has(fsnotify.Create) {
+				continue
+			}
+			createdName := filepath.Base(event.Name)
+			// Check if this is the hash-based directory
+			if createdName == hashName {
+				slog.Debug("Gemini watcher: hash-based project directory created", "path", event.Name)
+				return event.Name, nil
+			}
+			// Check if the new directory has a matching .project_root
+			if matchesProjectRoot(event.Name, canonicalProjectPath) {
+				slog.Debug("Gemini watcher: project directory created with matching .project_root",
+					"path", event.Name)
+				return event.Name, nil
+			}
+		case err, ok := <-watcher.Errors:
+			if !ok {
+				return "", fmt.Errorf("fsnotify errors channel closed for project dir watcher")
+			}
+			return "", fmt.Errorf("fsnotify watcher error for project dir: %w", err)
+		}
+	}
+}

+// waitForDirectoryFsnotify waits for a directory to exist using fsnotify on its parent.
+// The parent directory must already exist; if it doesn't, the function returns an error
+// instead of polling forever. This mirrors the Claude Code watcher pattern.
+func waitForDirectoryFsnotify(ctx context.Context, dir string, label string) error {
+	// Check if directory already exists
+	info, err := os.Stat(dir)
+	if err == nil && info.IsDir() {
+		slog.Debug("Gemini watcher: directory ready", "label", label, "path", dir)
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	parentDir := filepath.Dir(dir)
+	childName := filepath.Base(dir)
+
+	// Parent must exist — caller guarantees this via the sequential wait chain
+	if _, err := os.Stat(parentDir); err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("parent directory %q does not exist for %s: %w", parentDir, label, err)
+	}
 
+	watcher, err := fsnotify.NewWatcher()
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create fsnotify watcher for %s: %w", label, err)
+	}
+	defer func() { _ = watcher.Close() }()
+
+	if err := watcher.Add(parentDir); err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("failed to watch parent directory %q for %s: %w", parentDir, label, err)
+	}
+
+	slog.Debug("Gemini watcher: watching for directory creation", "label", label, "parent", parentDir, "child", childName)
+
+	// Re-check after adding watcher to close the race window
+	info, err = os.Stat(dir)
+	if err == nil && info.IsDir() {
+		slog.Debug("Gemini watcher: directory ready", "label", label, "path", dir)
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	for {
 		select {
 		case <-ctx.Done():
 			return ctx.Err()
-		case <-time.After(backoff):
-			if backoff < maxBackoff {
-				backoff *= 2
-				if backoff > maxBackoff {
-					backoff = maxBackoff
-				}
+		case event, ok := <-watcher.Events:
+			if !ok {
+				return fmt.Errorf("fsnotify events channel closed for %s", label)
+			}
+			if event.Has(fsnotify.Create) && filepath.Base(event.Name) == childName {
+				slog.Debug("Gemini watcher: directory ready", "label", label, "path", dir)
+				return nil
+			}
+		case err, ok := <-watcher.Errors:
+			if !ok {
+				return fmt.Errorf("fsnotify errors channel closed for %s", label)
 			}
+			return fmt.Errorf("fsnotify watcher error for %s: %w", label, err)
 		}
 	}

```text
    37→// HashProjectPath deterministically hashes an absolute project path using SHA256.
    38→// On case-insensitive filesystems (macOS), it resolves the path to its canonical
    39→// form with the correct case to ensure consistent hashing.
    40→func HashProjectPath(projectPath string) (string, error) {
    41→	if projectPath == "" {
    42→		return "", fmt.Errorf("project path is empty")
    43→	}
    44→
    45→	absPath, err := filepath.Abs(projectPath)
    46→	if err != nil {
    47→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve absolute path for %q: %w", projectPath, err)
    48→	}
    49→
    50→	// Resolve to canonical path with correct case (important for case-insensitive filesystems like macOS)
    51→	canonicalPath, err := spi.GetCanonicalPath(absPath)
    52→	if err != nil {
    53→		// If getting canonical path fails, use absPath as fallback
    54→		slog.Warn("HashProjectPath: Failed to get canonical path, using absolute path",
    55→			"absPath", absPath,
    56→			"error", err)
    57→		canonicalPath = absPath
    58→	} else if canonicalPath != absPath {
    59→		// Log when the path was canonicalized (case was corrected)
    60→		slog.Debug("HashProjectPath: Resolved path to canonical form",
    61→			"original", absPath,
    62→			"canonical", canonicalPath)
    63→	}
    64→
    65→	hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(canonicalPath))
    66→	return hex.EncodeToString(hash[:]), nil
    67→}

   114→//  3. Full scan — read every .project_root in tmpDir (handles suffixed dirs like my-project-1)
   115→func ResolveGeminiProjectDir(projectPath string) (string, error) {

   194→// matchesProjectRoot checks whether dir contains a .project_root file whose
   195→// content matches canonicalProjectPath (after canonicalization).
   196→func matchesProjectRoot(dir, canonicalProjectPath string) bool {
   197→	content, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, ".project_root"))
   198→	if err != nil {
   199→		return false
   200→	}
   201→
   202→	storedPath := strings.TrimSpace(string(content))
   203→	canonicalStored, err := spi.GetCanonicalPath(storedPath)
   204→	if err != nil {
   205→		slog.Warn("matchesProjectRoot: Failed to canonicalize stored path, using as-is",
   206→			"storedPath", storedPath, "error", err)
   207→		canonicalStored = storedPath
   208→	}
   209→
   210→	return canonicalStored == canonicalProjectPath
   211→}
   212→
   213→// canonicalizeProjectPath returns the canonical form of projectPath for
   214→// case-insensitive filesystem matching. Falls back to the original path on error.
   215→func canonicalizeProjectPath(projectPath string) string {
   216→	canonical, err := spi.GetCanonicalPath(projectPath)
   217→	if err != nil {
   218→		slog.Warn("canonicalizeProjectPath: Failed to canonicalize, using as-is",
   219→			"projectPath", projectPath, "error", err)
   220→		return projectPath
   221→	}
   222→	return canonical
   223→}

   225→// findProjectDirByBasename tries the most likely name-based directory first:
   226→// tmpDir/<basename>. Returns the directory path if its .project_root matches,
   227→// or empty string otherwise.
   228→func findProjectDirByBasename(tmpDir, projectPath, canonicalProjectPath string) string {
   229→	basename := filepath.Base(projectPath)
   230→	candidate := filepath.Join(tmpDir, basename)
   231→
   232→	info, err := osStat(candidate)
   233→	if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
   234→		return ""
   235→	}
   236→
   237→	if matchesProjectRoot(candidate, canonicalProjectPath) {
   238→		slog.Info("findProjectDirByBasename: Matched project directory via basename hint",
   239→			"dir", candidate, "projectPath", projectPath)
   240→		return candidate
   241→	}
   242→
   243→	return ""
   244→}

   246→// findProjectDirByProjectRoot scans tmpDir for any subdirectory whose .project_root
   247→// file content matches projectPath. This supports Gemini CLI v0.30.0+ which uses
   248→// project-name-based directories (possibly with numeric suffixes like my-project-1).
   249→func findProjectDirByProjectRoot(tmpDir, projectPath string) (string, error) {
   250→	canonicalProjectPath := canonicalizeProjectPath(projectPath)

   252→	entries, err := os.ReadDir(tmpDir)
   253→	if err != nil {
   254→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to read Gemini tmp directory %q: %w", tmpDir, err)
   255→	}
   256→
   257→	for _, entry := range entries {
   258→		if !entry.IsDir() {
   259→			continue
   260→		}
   261→
   262→		dir := filepath.Join(tmpDir, entry.Name())
   263→		if matchesProjectRoot(dir, canonicalProjectPath) {
   264→			slog.Info("findProjectDirByProjectRoot: Found matching project directory via .project_root",
   265→				"dir", dir, "projectPath", projectPath)
   266→			return dir, nil
   267→		}
   268→	}
   269→
   270→	return "", nil
   271→}

   273→// ListGeminiProjectHashes returns the list of project hash directories currently on disk.

   283→	}
```

```text
    95→		resolvedDir, err := waitForProjectDir(watcherCtx, tmpDir, projectPath, hashDir)
    96→		if err != nil {

    98→			return

   123→// waitForProjectDir waits for a Gemini project directory using three strategies:
   124→//  1. Basename hint — tmpDir/<project-basename> with matching .project_root
   125→//  2. Hash-based — the legacy hash directory
   126→//  3. Full .project_root scan — handles suffixed dirs like my-project-1
   127→//
   128→// If none exist yet, it watches tmpDir for new directory creation.
   129→func waitForProjectDir(ctx context.Context, tmpDir, projectPath, hashDir string) (string, error) {
   130→	canonicalProjectPath := canonicalizeProjectPath(projectPath)
   131→	hashName := filepath.Base(hashDir)
   132→
   133→	// checkAll runs all three strategies and returns the first match.
   134→	checkAll := func() string {
   135→		// 1. Basename hint
   136→		if dir := findProjectDirByBasename(tmpDir, projectPath, canonicalProjectPath); dir != "" {
   137→			return dir
   138→		}
   139→		// 2. Hash-based
   140→		if info, err := os.Stat(hashDir); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
   141→			slog.Debug("Gemini watcher: hash-based project directory ready", "path", hashDir)
   142→			return hashDir
   143→		}
   144→		// 3. Full scan
   145→		if match, err := findProjectDirByProjectRoot(tmpDir, projectPath); err == nil && match != "" {
   146→			return match
   147→		}
   148→		return ""
   149→	}
   150→
   151→	// Try existing directories first
   152→	if dir := checkAll(); dir != "" {
   153→		return dir, nil
   154→	}
   155→
   156→	// Nothing exists yet — watch tmpDir for new directory creation
   157→	watcher, err := fsnotify.NewWatcher()
   158→	if err != nil {
   159→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create fsnotify watcher for project dir: %w", err)
   160→	}
   161→	defer func() { _ = watcher.Close() }()
   162→
   163→	if err := watcher.Add(tmpDir); err != nil {
   164→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to watch tmp directory %q: %w", tmpDir, err)
   165→	}
   166→
   167→	slog.Debug("Gemini watcher: watching for project directory creation",
   168→		"tmpDir", tmpDir, "hashDir", hashName)
   169→
   170→	// Re-check after adding watcher to close the race window
   171→	if dir := checkAll(); dir != "" {
   172→		return dir, nil
   173→	}
   174→
   175→	for {
   176→		select {
   177→		case <-ctx.Done():
   178→			return "", ctx.Err()
   179→		case event, ok := <-watcher.Events:
   180→			if !ok {
   181→				return "", fmt.Errorf("fsnotify events channel closed for project dir watcher")
   182→			}
   183→			if !event.Has(fsnotify.Create) {
   184→				continue
   185→			}
   186→			createdName := filepath.Base(event.Name)
   187→			// Check if this is the hash-based directory
   188→			if createdName == hashName {
   189→				slog.Debug("Gemini watcher: hash-based project directory created", "path", event.Name)
   190→				return event.Name, nil
   191→			}
   192→			// Check if the new directory has a matching .project_root
   193→			if matchesProjectRoot(event.Name, canonicalProjectPath) {
   194→				slog.Debug("Gemini watcher: project directory created with matching .project_root",
   195→					"path", event.Name)
   196→				return event.Name, nil
   197→			}
   198→		case err, ok := <-watcher.Errors:
   199→			if !ok {
   200→				return "", fmt.Errorf("fsnotify errors channel closed for project dir watcher")
   201→			}
   202→			return "", fmt.Errorf("fsnotify watcher error for project dir: %w", err)
   203→		}
   204→	}
   205→}

   207→func startChatsWatcher(chatsDir string) error {

   209→	if err != nil {
   210→		return err
   211→	}
   212→
   213→	watcherWg.Add(1)
   214→	go func() {
   215→		defer watcherWg.Done()
   216→		defer func() {
   217→			_ = watcher.Close()
   218→		}()
   219→
   220→		if err := watcher.Add(chatsDir); err != nil {
   221→			slog.Error("Failed to add chats dir to watcher", "error", err)
   222→			return
   223→		}
   224→
   225→		for {
   226→			select {
   227→			case <-watcherCtx.Done():
   228→				return
   229→			case event, ok := <-watcher.Events:
   230→				if !ok {
   231→					return
   232→				}
   233→				if strings.HasSuffix(event.Name, ".json") && (event.Has(fsnotify.Write) || event.Has(fsnotify.Create)) {
   234→					processSessionChange(event.Name)
   235→				}
   236→			case err, ok := <-watcher.Errors:
   237→				if !ok {
   238→					return
   239→				}
   240→				slog.Error("Watcher error", "error", err)
   241→			}
   242→		}
   243→	}()
   244→
   245→	return nil
   246→}

   248→func processSessionChange(filePath string) {
   249→	slog.Debug("processSessionChange: Detected session file change", "file", filePath)
   250→
   251→	// Extract short session ID from filename to find related files
   252→	filename := filepath.Base(filePath)
   253→	shortID := extractSessionIDFromFilename(filename)
   254→	if shortID == "" {
   255→		slog.Error("processSessionChange: Could not extract session ID from filename", "file", filename)
   256→		return
   257→	}
   258→
   259→	// Parse the changed file to get the full session ID
   260→	session, err := ParseSessionFile(filePath)
   261→	if err != nil {
   262→		slog.Error("processSessionChange: Failed to parse session file", "file", filePath, "error", err)
   263→		return
   264→	}
   265→
   266→	fullSessionID := session.ID
   267→
   268→	// Find all files for this session to merge them
   269→	// Why: Gemini CLI may have created multiple files for this session
   270→	chatsDir := filepath.Dir(filePath)
   271→	entries, err := os.ReadDir(chatsDir)
   272→	if err != nil {
   273→		slog.Error("processSessionChange: Failed to read chats directory", "dir", chatsDir, "error", err)
   274→		// Fall back to single-file session
   275→		agentSession := convertToAgentChatSession(session, getWatcherWorkspaceRoot(), getWatcherDebugRaw())
   276→		triggerCallback(agentSession)
   277→		return
   278→	}
   279→
   280→	// Collect all files that match this session's short ID
   281→	var sessionFiles []string
   282→	for _, entry := range entries {
   283→		if entry.IsDir() {
   284→			continue
   285→		}
   286→		if extractSessionIDFromFilename(entry.Name()) == shortID {
   287→			sessionFiles = append(sessionFiles, filepath.Join(chatsDir, entry.Name()))
   288→		}
   289→	}
   290→
   291→	slog.Debug("processSessionChange: Found session files to merge",
   292→		"shortID", shortID,
   293→		"fileCount", len(sessionFiles))
   294→
   295→	// Merge all files for this session
   296→	mergedSession, err := parseAndMergeSessionFiles(shortID, sessionFiles)
   297→	if err != nil {
   298→		slog.Error("processSessionChange: Failed to merge session files",
   299→			"sessionId", fullSessionID,
   300→			"fileCount", len(sessionFiles),
   301→			"error", err)
   302→		// Fall back to single-file session
   303→		agentSession := convertToAgentChatSession(session, getWatcherWorkspaceRoot(), getWatcherDebugRaw())
   304→		triggerCallback(agentSession)
   305→		return
   306→	}
   307→
   308→	slog.Info("processSessionChange: Successfully processed session change",
   309→		"sessionId", mergedSession.ID,
   310→		"fileCount", len(sessionFiles),
   311→		"messageCount", len(mergedSession.Messages),
   312→		"startTime", mergedSession.StartTime,
   313→		"lastUpdated", mergedSession.LastUpdated)
   314→
   315→	agentSession := convertToAgentChatSession(mergedSession, getWatcherWorkspaceRoot(), getWatcherDebugRaw())
   316→	triggerCallback(agentSession)
   317→}
   318→
   319→// triggerCallback is a helper to call the watcher callback with proper locking
   320→func triggerCallback(agentSession *spi.AgentChatSession) {
   321→	watcherMutex.RLock()
   322→	cb := watcherCallback
   323→	watcherMutex.RUnlock()
   324→
   325→	if cb != nil && agentSession != nil {
   326→		cb(agentSession)
   327→	}
   328→}

   330→// waitForDirectoryFsnotify waits for a directory to exist using fsnotify on its parent.
   331→// The parent directory must already exist; if it doesn't, the function returns an error
   332→// instead of polling forever. This mirrors the Claude Code watcher pattern.
   333→func waitForDirectoryFsnotify(ctx context.Context, dir string, label string) error {
   334→	// Check if directory already exists
   335→	info, err := os.Stat(dir)
   336→	if err == nil && info.IsDir() {
   337→		slog.Debug("Gemini watcher: directory ready", "label", label, "path", dir)
   338→		return nil
   339→	}
   340→
   341→	parentDir := filepath.Dir(dir)
   342→	childName := filepath.Base(dir)
   343→
   344→	// Parent must exist — caller guarantees this via the sequential wait chain
   345→	if _, err := os.Stat(parentDir); err != nil {
   346→		return fmt.Errorf("parent directory %q does not exist for %s: %w", parentDir, label, err)
   347→	}
   348→
   349→	watcher, err := fsnotify.NewWatcher()
   350→	if err != nil {
   351→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create fsnotify watcher for %s: %w", label, err)
   352→	}
   353→	defer func() { _ = watcher.Close() }()
   354→
   355→	if err := watcher.Add(parentDir); err != nil {
   356→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to watch parent directory %q for %s: %w", parentDir, label, err)
   357→	}
   358→
   359→	slog.Debug("Gemini watcher: watching for directory creation", "label", label, "parent", parentDir, "child", childName)
   360→
   361→	// Re-check after adding watcher to close the race window
   362→	info, err = os.Stat(dir)
   363→	if err == nil && info.IsDir() {
   364→		slog.Debug("Gemini watcher: directory ready", "label", label, "path", dir)
   365→		return nil
   366→	}
   367→
   368→	for {
   369→		select {
   370→		case <-ctx.Done():
   371→			return ctx.Err()
   372→		case event, ok := <-watcher.Events:
   373→			if !ok {
   374→				return fmt.Errorf("fsnotify events channel closed for %s", label)
   375→			}
   376→			if event.Has(fsnotify.Create) && filepath.Base(event.Name) == childName {
   377→				slog.Debug("Gemini watcher: directory ready", "label", label, "path", dir)
   378→				return nil
   379→			}
   380→		case err, ok := <-watcher.Errors:
   381→			if !ok {
   382→				return fmt.Errorf("fsnotify errors channel closed for %s", label)
   383→			}
   384→			return fmt.Errorf("fsnotify watcher error for %s: %w", label, err)
   385→		}
   386→	}
   387→}
   388→
   389→func startArtifactWatcher(filePath string, label string) error {
   390→	dir := filepath.Dir(filePath)
   391→	watcher, err := fsnotify.NewWatcher()
   392→	if err != nil {
   393→		return err
   394→	}
   395→
   396→	if err := watcher.Add(dir); err != nil {
   397→		_ = watcher.Close()
   398→		return err
   399→	}
   400→
   401→	watcherWg.Add(1)
   402→	go func() {
   403→		defer watcherWg.Done()
   404→		defer func() {
   405→			_ = watcher.Close()
   406→		}()
   407→
   408→		slog.Info("Gemini watcher: monitoring artifact", "artifact", label, "path", filePath)
   409→
   410→		for {
   411→			select {
   412→			case <-watcherCtx.Done():
   413→				return
   414→			case event, ok := <-watcher.Events:
   415→				if !ok {
   416→					return
   417→				}
   418→				if filepath.Clean(event.Name) != filepath.Clean(filePath) {
   419→					continue
   420→				}
   421→				if event.Has(fsnotify.Write) || event.Has(fsnotify.Create) {
   422→					slog.Info("Gemini artifact updated", "artifact", label, "path", event.Name, "op", event.Op.String())
   423→				}
   424→			case err, ok := <-watcher.Errors:
   425→				if !ok {
   426→					return
   427→				}
   428→				slog.Warn("Gemini artifact watcher error", "artifact", label, "error", err)
   429→			}
   430→		}
   431→	}()
   432→
   433→	return nil
   434→}
   435→
```

## Top 5 Improvements

1. **Race condition in `waitForProjectDir` event handling (observation 51)**: When a new directory appears in tmpDir and `matchesProjectRoot` is called immediately, the `.project_root` file may not exist yet. Consider either: (a) after detecting a new directory that doesn't match hash, briefly watch that new directory for `.project_root` creation, or (b) call `checkAll()` instead of `matchesProjectRoot(event.Name, ...)` on each Create event, which would also catch directories that appeared between events.

2. **Silent error swallowing in strategy 2 and 3 of `ResolveGeminiProjectDir` (observations 12, 13)**: Non-`ErrNotExist` errors from `osStat(hashDir)` on line 154 and `scanErr` from `findProjectDirByProjectRoot` on line 161 are silently swallowed. At minimum, log them at Debug or Warn level so filesystem permission errors or other unexpected failures are visible.

3. **Duplicate `osGetwd()` resolution (observation 8)**: Both `GetGeminiProjectDir` (line 81-87) and `ResolveGeminiProjectDir` (line 124-127) independently resolve an empty `projectPath` via `osGetwd()`. This is a minor DRY concern — consider having `GetGeminiProjectDir` return the resolved path, or having `ResolveGeminiProjectDir` pass the resolved path explicitly.

4. **Changelog category for fsnotify change (observation 4)**: The polling-to-fsnotify change is categorized as a "Bug Fix" but is more accurately an improvement/optimization. The polling wasn't broken — it was just noisy and CPU-wasteful. Consider moving it to "Improvements."

5. **Missing test for basename hint strategy (observation 38)**: There's no integration-level test that exercises strategy 1 (basename hint) of `ResolveGeminiProjectDir`. `TestResolveGeminiProjectDirViaProjectRoot` only exercises strategy 3. Adding a test where the temp dir basename matches the `.project_root` directory name would verify the fast path works end-to-end.

## Test Assessment

### `TestFindProjectDirByProjectRoot` (lines 123-201)

- **Not trivial**: ✅ Tests our `.project_root` file reading, canonicalization, and matching logic
- **Not tautological**: ✅ Would catch real bugs — e.g., if we forgot to skip non-directory entries, or if `TrimSpace` was removed
- **Well-designed**: ✅ Four distinct scenarios covering the important cases. Data-driven with table-driven pattern
- **Reliable**: ✅ Uses `t.TempDir()` for isolation, no external dependencies
- **Not repetitive**: ✅ Each case tests a different scenario

### `TestResolveGeminiProjectDirViaProjectRoot` (lines 203-247)

- **Not trivial**: ✅ Tests the full resolution flow including the fallback from hash-based to `.project_root`-based lookup
- **Not tautological**: ✅ Would catch regressions if the strategy ordering or `.project_root` integration broke
- **Well-designed**: ✅ Sets up a realistic scenario where the hash directory doesn't exist but `.project_root` does
- **Reliable**: ✅ Uses real temp dirs and function mocking; the comment about canonical paths (line 213) shows awareness of the pitfall
- **Not repetitive**: ✅ Distinct from `TestFindProjectDirByProjectRoot` which tests the lower-level function directly

### Missing test coverage worth adding

- **`findProjectDirByBasename`** — This function has no dedicated unit test. It's a simple function, but a table-driven test with "match", "no match", "not a directory" cases would verify the basename-first optimization.
- **`waitForProjectDir`** — The watcher integration is harder to unit test, but if you have any integration or smoke test infrastructure, the race-condition-closing logic (check → add watcher → re-check) is the kind of subtle thing worth testing.

_**Agent (claude-opus-4-6 2026-03-02 23:43:05Z)**_

All 6 observations addressed. Here's a summary of what changed:

**#8 — Duplicate `osGetwd()` resolution**: Moved `projectPath` resolution to the top of `ResolveGeminiProjectDir` (lines 116-123), before `GetGeminiProjectDir` is called. Now `projectPath` is resolved exactly once and passed as non-empty to `GetGeminiProjectDir`, which skips its own `osGetwd()` call. Also removed the `resolvedProjectPath` variable and the guard clauses around strategies 1 and 3 (no longer needed since `projectPath` is guaranteed non-empty).

**#12 — Silent error swallowing in strategy 2**: Added an `else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist)` branch (lines 158-161) that logs unexpected errors (e.g., permission errors) at Warn level instead of silently treating them as "not found."

**#13 — Silent error swallowing in strategy 3**: Restructured the strategy 3 block (lines 164-170) to check `scanErr != nil` first and log it at Warn level, rather than silently falling through.

**#18 — `matchesProjectRoot` param documentation**: Expanded the doc comment (lines 199-202) to explicitly state that `canonicalProjectPath` must already be in canonical form, referencing the helper functions that produce it.

**#51 — Race condition in `waitForProjectDir`**: Replaced the specific `matchesProjectRoot` check on Create events with a `checkAll()` call (lines 186-192). Now any Create event in tmpDir triggers a full re-scan of all three strategies, which catches directories whose `.project_root` file wasn't yet written when the directory first appeared.

**#57 — Missing `label` param description**: Added description of the `label` parameter to the `waitForDirectoryFsnotify` doc comment (line 333).
